title: 7 lines of code, 3 minutes: Implement a programming language (2010)
summary: Matt Might demonstrates how to implement a simple programming language (a Lisp-like functional language) in just 7 lines of code, covering parsing, evaluation, and execution in a concise tutorial format.
problem_solved: Demystifies language implementation by showing how to build a working interpreter in minimal code.
why_valuable: Proves that language implementation is accessible by breaking down the core concepts (parsing and evaluation) into a practical, understandable example.
